issue.title: Tag `v1.4.12` removed?
issue.body: Hi! Homebrew contributor here. We noticed that tag `v1.4.12` was removed. Was that intended?

comments.body: Sorry, I pushed it by mistake. It was a duplicate of v1.4.11.

@julianoes thanks for confirming that was intended, any timeline plan for a new release any time soon (asking so that we don't have to downgrade the mavsdk, which is some painful process for homebrew side). Thanks a lot!
Ok, I'll try to make a release tomorrow to make this easier for you. Thanks!

I've released v1.4.12, hopefully that works for you.
https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/tag/v1.4.12
And thank you for maintaining the homebrew updates!
